articulation.label: sun
articulation.alt: sun: /s/ → /ʌ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: cup
articulation.alt: cup: /k/ → /ʌ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bus
articulation.alt: bus: /b/ → /ʌ/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: hut
articulation.alt: hut: /h/ → /ʌ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
